author: (C. B. Adams, 1845)

note.en: A small dove snail on the Costa Rican Caribbean catalogue, too small to notice. Size and depth are typical values for the group, not measured locally.
note.es: Un caracol paloma pequeño del catálogo del Caribe de Costa Rica, demasiado chico para notarlo. El tamaño y la profundidad son valores típicos del grupo, no medidos localmente.

evidence: Added: not in the original record list for this part

sources.t: Rodríguez Sevilla, Vargas & Cortés 2003, Gastrópodos de la costa Caribe de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 51 (Suppl. 3): 305-399
WoRMS: Parvanachis obesa (C. B. Adams, 1845), accepted name
